scenes.caption: Choosing.
scenes.say: It is the first day of school. Layla picks her blue scarf.

scenes.caption: Soft.
scenes.say: It is soft and silky. It is as blue as the sky.

scenes.caption: Nani.
scenes.say: Nani gave it to her for Eid. That makes it special.

scenes.caption: The walk.
scenes.say: Layla walks to school. She feels a little nervous.

scenes.caption: A friend.
scenes.say: Her friend Hana says, That is beautiful!

scenes.caption: Proud.
scenes.say: Layla smiles and stands tall. She feels proud.

scenes.caption: Sharing.
scenes.say: In class, she tells everyone why blue is special to her.

scenes.caption: The end.
scenes.say: Everyone listens kindly. Different things matter to different people.
